name: painted_ignite
direction: Soft matte gouache, broad simple shapes, painted depth and stable texture. Sol uses gentle connected body/tip wiggle, with supported feet and no emitted particles. Animate on twos at final30fps,15 pose updates/sec,normal speed; enforce and verify during editing.
sol: Original compact asymmetric flame design and red/orange/cream layers; original uniformly navy #1C2447 open eye ovals attached to the face, tiny rounded limbs, no mouth. Small coherent action-driven body/flame flex is allowed; no independent facial movement or redesigned anatomy. A brief natural blink is allowed.

animation.editorial_camera: Smooth transforms may follow stepped source; check crops throughout.
animation.implementation_status: Required generation target and editing/verification policy; not evidence of implemented or verified footage.
animation.sol_performance: Move Sol through each short gesture with a gentle connected body-and-tip wiggle, then settle into the supplied ending pose. Keep both feet supported. His filled red/orange/cream layers, face and original lobes move together as one compact painted form. No particles, sparks, brush-flecks, droplets, detached flame shapes, airborne hops or body splitting. During Narrator speech, establish body-led attention UP toward the fixed point just above camera before the first word and maintain it with quiet connected listening idle. Keep the normal-height close-spaced navy oval eyes unchanged; a brief natural blink is allowed. No extra gestures, windup, repeated nodding or camera movement.
animation.scope: Gentle connected wiggle belongs to Sol; hands, props, mechanisms and cameras follow their own planned motion.
animation.sol_blink: A brief natural blink is allowed, returning promptly to the original open navy oval design; no unrelated eye morphs, highlights or facial drift.
animation.narrator_attention: Mandatory whenever Narrator speaks with Sol visible: gaze UP to fixed above-camera voice before first word, maintained with gentle body/tip/lobe listening idle throughout. Review against script and actual voice cues when available.

flame_accents.direction: Sol emits no particles, sparks, flecks, droplets or detached flame accents at any time. All wiggle and tip follow-through stays attached to his continuous filled body. The separate wood fire may flicker only at its fixed fuel contact.
